integrity: Exact all-length proof plus standalone finite-instance rank/count verification for n=1,...,11; computational observations are not substituted for infinite proof. Published initial graph definition and edge counts explicitly attributed to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight undirected tilde-Fibonacci cubes on linear 11-avoiding binary words only; counts of distinct optimal bases, mixed-square replacements, and other forbidden factors are not determined. Earlier equivalent graph-augmentation principles may exist under different terminology.
title: Exact minimum cycle bases of swap-and-mismatch Fibonacci cubes
